mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_REPLY (INSTANCE_ID, REPLY, DEGRADED, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{reply}, #{degraded}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE REPLY=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(REPLY) ELSE REPLY END, DEGRADED=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(DEGRADED) ELSE DEGRADED END, UPDATED_AT=CASE WHEN DELETED=0 THEN VALUES(UPDATED_AT) ELSE UPDATED_AT END
mapper.select: SELECT REPLY FROM WF_REPLY WHERE DELETED=0 AND (INSTANCE_ID = #{instanceId})
mapper.update: UPDATE WF_REPLY SET DELETED=1 WHERE DELETED=0 AND (INSTANCE_ID = #{instanceId})
